versions.changelog:
- No changes detected in files for version 2.0.1.
- Skill description updated to "Test Skill" with a brief statement.
- All previous documentation and detailed instructions have been replaced.

dp-ops-advisor 2.0.0 introduces major operational and authentication enhancements.

- Enforces mandatory API Key authentication; forbids session-based login for increased security.
- Adds comprehensive onboarding instructions for first-time users, including API Key setup steps.
- Defines strict API usage quotas (free: 100 calls/month, upgrade options available).
- Expands capabilities: real-time job health checks, throughput & latency analysis, auto-restart, incident reporting, configuration recommendations.
- Updated workflow documentation for all key operational support scenarios.
